papers.t: Novel field trial for ocean alkalinity enhancement using electrochemically derived aqueous alkalinity

Project Macoma: mCDR/ OAE field trial dataset of water temperature, pH, total alkalinity, ADCP, other variables, and reports collected from sensor and discrete observations in Port Angeles Harbor, WA, USA from 2024-06-05 to 2026-03-11 (NCEI Accession 0315543)
